name: yield-xyz-agentkit-pulse-verify
description: The Pulse Network verification connector — deterministic pre-execution checks (token safety, holder concentration, exit depth, independent APY reads) before Yield.xyz actions. Requires the yield-xyz-agentkit plugin — install it too.

interface.shortDescription: Deterministic pre-execution verification for yields — pay-per-call via x402.
interface.longDescription: Connects the Yield.xyz AgentKit to Pulse Network's verification endpoints: token safety scans, holder concentration, exit depth, and independent on-chain APY reads, each paid per call in USDC via x402 with no API key. Install alongside the Yield.xyz AgentKit plugin.
defaultPrompt: Verify this yield's reward token before I enter.
Cross-check this vault's APY against on-chain state.
Run a full due-diligence report on this token.
